entry.title: Raymond James CEO on 4Q Earnings and AI Strategy
entry.summary: Raymond James shares rose after the company beat estimates for fourth-quarter revenue and adjusted EPS, with investment banking revenue also exceeding expectations. CEO Paul Shoukry said Raymond James focuses on sustainable growth and long-term decisions, noting 155 consecutive profitable quarters. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
